quests.name: Study the Scriptures
quests.description: Dedicate at least 15 minutes each day to studying the scriptures. This daily habit will help you strengthen your testimony, receive personal revelation, and draw closer to God.

quests.name: Morning Prayer
quests.description: Begin each day with a sincere prayer, expressing gratitude and seeking guidance for the challenges and opportunities ahead. This practice invites the Spirit and sets a positive tone for your day.

quests.name: Evening Prayer
quests.description: End each day with prayer, reflecting on your experiences, expressing thanks, and asking for forgiveness and protection. This habit helps you maintain a close relationship with Heavenly Father.

quests.name: Pray Before Meals
quests.description: Offer a prayer of gratitude before each meal, recognizing the Lord's hand in providing for your needs and inviting His blessings upon your food and those who prepared it.
